headline: Kruk's 13th-inning single beats the Cubs
recap: John Kruk singled to left in the bottom of the 13th to score Steve Lake and give the Phillies a 6-5 walk-off win over the Cubs at Veterans Stadium. Lake had opened the inning with a double and John Morris was hit by a pitch before Kruk delivered against Paul Assenmacher, who took the loss. Kruk finished 4 for 6 with two RBI.

Philadelphia started the night in a hole. Tommy Greene did not record an out, charged with four earned runs on five hits and a walk, and Chicago led 4-0 after the top of the first on RBI singles by Ryne Sandberg and Hector Villanueva following a Mark Grace double. Sandberg added a home run in the fifth for a 5-2 Cubs lead. The Phillies got two runs in the fourth on a Dale Murphy double, two more in the sixth, and tied it at 5-5 in the ninth when Charlie Hayes singled in Dickie Thon.

Danny Cox followed Greene and went five innings, allowing one run, the Sandberg homer. Mike Hartley, Joe Boever and Mitch Williams each pitched two scoreless innings, and Bruce Ruffin threw the final two for the win. Frank Castillo went eight innings for Chicago and was charged with four earned runs.
